title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts, grade a landing as reached only when the commit was
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts, grade a landing as reached only when the commit was actually pushed, instead of whenever a local commit exists.

WHY. emitLandingTrace grades every landing reached:true unconditionally. The comment above it states the premise plainly — "reached:true is HONEST here and only here. This helper runs after the commit exists and the push has been attempted" — and that premise was falsified on 2026-09-14. The container's git credential failed between 00:52 and 02:30 UTC; five substrate-authored commits were created with push_status "host_sync_pending", each was graded reached:true on the strength of a LOCAL sha, and substrate-pull-sync then ran reset --hard origin/dev and destroyed all five. A commit that exists locally is not a landing. CLAUDE.md defines the autonomy criterion as a substrate-authored commit landing on the REMOTE working branch, so grading on a local sha silently redefines the very thing it measures, and it feeds the ribosome exactly the hollow executions law 4 warns about.

This also makes the outage self-reporting with no new detector: when pushes fail, cutover reach falls to zero, and reach_rate_scan already mints a reach-rate gap for a family that stops reaching. Today a credential outage is invisible because every cutover still reports success.

THE CHANGE. Exactly one op, on an executable statement. Find this line, which occurs exactly once in the file:

          body: JSON.stringify({ execution_id: execId, reached: true, completion_shapes: ["cutoverApplied"] }),

Replace that single line with exactly this line:

          body: JSON.stringify({ execution_id: execId, reached: String(appliedBody["push_status"] ?? "") === "pushed", completion_shapes: ["cutoverApplied"] }),

WHAT THIS CHANGES AT RUNTIME. This is not cosmetic. appliedBody is this function's first parameter and already supplies push_status to the metadata a few lines above, so the value is in scope. Today every landing posts reached:true; afterwards a landing whose push_status is "host_sync_pending" posts reached:false, so the ribosome will not extract a template from a commit that was never pushed, and the reach rate for vessel_mitosis_cutover reflects commits that survived rather than commits that were merely authored.

SCOPE. One replacement only, on that single line. Do not change the execution POST above it, the metadata block, the completion_shapes value, or the surrounding catch handlers. Do not alter the comment; it documents the old premise and the commit message will record why it is now wrong.
